name: Solex Energy Ltd
tagline: Recently mainboard-migrated solar-module manufacturer scaling aggressively toward a 15GW-by-2030 vision - down ~46% from highs after a disputed Q2FY26 revenue miss, statistically cheap post-crash (~10.5x TTM P/E) but facing a genuinely contested oversupply/commoditisation debate and a delayed cell-line
business_overview: Incorporated 1995, Solex Energy manufactures solar photovoltaic cells and modules and does EPC in the solar-energy market, based in Gujarat. Completed SME-to-mainboard migration (Oct 2025). Vision 2030 targets 15GW module + 5GW cell manufacturing capacity; current module capacity ~4GW (2.5GW line commissioned Oct-Nov 2025), cell line pushed to ~FY27 (from an earlier FY26 target). (Source: external-lead, @ankitbahuguna84, untrusted X triage, first_seen 2026-09-04.)
fundamentals_table: Rs 712.60 - Rs 745.00 (narrow, post-mainboard-migration range reset near lows)
~Rs 1,566 Cr; H1FY26 Rs 415 Cr (+52% YoY, but Q2 fell sequentially vs Q1's Rs 260 Cr)
Rs 2,000+ Cr (management) - implies ~Rs 1,600 Cr required in H2FY26
fundamentals_narrative: Genuine capacity and revenue scale-up (module capacity 700MW -> 4GW in ~2 years; TTM revenue already Rs 1,566 Cr) at a market cap that has been cut nearly in half (-45.7% 1yr) - the stock is statistically cheap (~10.5x TTM P/E, 46% ROE) after the correction. But H1FY26 showed an unexplained sequential revenue drop in Q2 (management attributed it to extended Gujarat monsoon delaying deliveries; a trusted community member called this 'a red herring... still unexplained'), the cell line has slipped from an FY26 to an FY27 timeline, rising debtor days signal building working-capital strain, and the community has raised a genuine, unresolved oversupply/commoditisation concern (many Indian module manufacturers expanding capacity simultaneously; thin, book-value-multiple-driven valuations across the sector).
technical_read: Not pulled - fundamentals/thread read gave enough signal; stock already near 52-week lows post-correction.
sentiment_summary: 63-post thread (2024-2026) tracking capacity ramp, guidance, and post-mainboard-migration developments closely. Sentiment shifted from strongly bullish (2024, aggressive Vision-2030 framing) to genuinely divided after the ~50% price decline since Nov 2025, with a detailed bull/bear numerical debate (Agastya vs Prabhat_Mohanty) over whether H2FY26 guidance (Rs 1,600 Cr) is achievable.
community_signal: Prabhat_Mohanty (trusted) is explicitly skeptical post-correction (Jan 2026): called the Q2 revenue drop 'a red herring... still unexplained,' noted peers (Premier, Vikram) also showing weak numbers, and called the Rs 1,600 Cr H2 target 'a herculean task' while acknowledging the European order book as 'a silver lining.' Nabendu (trusted) was an early, detailed bull (Dec 2024 thread-opening post, 12 likes) tracking capacity milestones closely but has not weighed in on the post-correction debate in the fetched window. No trusted-user directional call in either direction post-crash - genuine, live disagreement.

trusted_signals.thread: Solex Energy - Undervalued Solar PV Manufacturer or Microcap Value Trap?
trusted_signals.note: Skeptical post-50%-correction: Q2FY26 sequential revenue drop is 'a red herring... still unexplained'; peers (Premier, Vikram) also weak; Rs 1,600 Cr H2FY26 target called 'a herculean task,' though European order book is a genuine positive.

bse_notes: No SEBI or fraud action found. Mainboard migration completed Oct 2025 (was delayed from an earlier June 2025 target due to ESM listing status).
bull_case: Real capacity scale-up already executed: 700MW -> 4GW module capacity in ~2 years
TTM revenue already Rs 1,566 Cr; ROE 46% (though partly reflects a small equity base pre-dilution)
Statistically cheap post ~46% correction: ~10.5x TTM P/E
Fresh Rs 500+ Cr European order win (Oct 2025) - genuine export diversification
Founder (Dr Chetan Shah) has a credible track record scaling a prior module manufacturer (Goldi Solar)
bear_case: Q2FY26 sequential revenue drop remains genuinely unexplained/disputed by a trusted community member
Cell-line commissioning slipped from FY26 to FY27 - a full capex-cycle delay on the margin-accretive part of the plan
Rising debtor days (61.9 -> 77.6) - working-capital strain building alongside the aggressive capex
Genuine, unresolved industry-wide oversupply/commoditisation concern (solar modules are a P/B-multiple, low-differentiation category)
H2FY26 guidance (Rs 1,600 Cr) called 'herculean' by a trusted, numerate community member
Peer weakness (Premier, Vikram) suggests this may be sector-wide, not company-specific
verdict_headline: Real capacity scale-up and statistically cheap post-correction (four-box score 3.0), but an unresolved Q2 revenue miss and a delayed cell line mean the label is allowed but unconfirmed - conviction capped at Low-Medium pending H2FY26 delivery against guidance.
verdict_reasoning: four_box: tailwind weak (real India solar demand but genuine, community-flagged industry oversupply/commoditisation risk), tam yes (4GW->15GW capacity roadmap gives real revenue-scaling headroom off an already-demonstrated Rs 1,566 Cr TTM base), moat weak (commodity module manufacturing, thin differentiation, European/domestic competition), valuation yes (~10.5x TTM P/E after a 46% market-cap correction) -> score 3.0

Score >=3.0 permits the 10x-in-2-3-years label; however the execution picture is genuinely mixed (disputed Q2 miss, cell-line delay, rising debtor days) so conviction is capped at Low-Medium with an explicit 'unconfirmed pending H2FY26 delivery' caveat rather than treated as a clean call

No red flag. Source is untrusted external-lead (X triage) - no conviction floor applies

four_box.note: Real capacity/revenue scale (4GW roadmap, Rs 1,566 Cr TTM revenue) and cheap post-correction valuation, offset by industry oversupply risk and a commodity-manufacturing moat

market_expectation.implied_growth_cagr: ~10x TTM on a commodity solar-module maker implies the market expects margins/returns to de-rate; a defensible ~10-12x exit needs only ~5-10% EPS CAGR FY26-28 - the multiple prices scepticism, not the 15GW roadmap
market_expectation.our_fy27_estimate: revenue Rs 2,000+ Cr if H2FY26 guidance lands and the 2.5GW line ramps; PAT sensitive to module ASPs in an oversupplied market
market_expectation.our_fy28_estimate: second leg only if the FY27 cell line commissions and pricing holds; module-only economics stay thin
market_expectation.gap_basis: market at ~10x is pricing the industry oversupply/commoditisation risk; the disputed Q2 miss and cell-line slip keep evidence weak, so our path is roughly what the multiple needs, not clearly above it
market_expectation.data_caveat: no broker consensus; implied path is a reverse-P/E estimate + screener.in forward figures + VP thread view

track_record.note: FY24-26 each cleared both filters: revenue growth 81-144% and ROCE 36-46%. Pre-FY24 filings limited (SME-to-mainboard migration Oct 2025); the record is a 3-year hyper-growth ramp, not a long history.
